en.description: FDNY Ladder 8. This firehouse was organized on October 16, 1865. It moved to its current location in 1905. The building itself was constructed in 1903. It's famous worldwide as the headquarters for the Ghostbusters. It has also appeared in the movies Hitch and an episode of Seinfeld. It was almost closed in 2011 but was saved by a public campaign.

Comedy Cellar. This famous comedy club opened its doors in 1982. It was founded by Bill Grundfest and Manny Dworman. Many famous comedians got their start here. They include Jon Stewart, Dave Chappelle, and Amy Schumer. The club is known for its intimate setting. It's a place where comedians test new material. Sometimes, big stars drop in for surprise sets. This has happened with comedians like Eddie Murphy.

The Flatiron District is a neighborhood named after its most famous building, the Flatiron Building. This iconic structure was completed in 1902. It was designed by architect Daniel Burnham. The building's unique triangular shape comes from its location where Fifth Avenue and Broadway meet. It was originally called the Fuller Building. The area around it quickly became known as the Flatiron District. Before the building, this spot was farmland. Later, it held hotels and apartment buildings. The building's design was so unusual that some people thought it would collapse! It's now a beloved symbol of the city.

Empire State Building. Construction began on March 17, 1930. It officially opened on May 1, 1931. The building was designed by Shreve, Lamb & Harmon Associates. It was the world's tallest building for nearly 40 years. It has been featured in over 250 films. The spire was originally designed as a mooring mast for airships, but no airship ever docked there.

Grand Central Terminal is a truly iconic landmark. It first opened its doors in 1871 as Grand Central Depot. It was later rebuilt and renamed Grand Central Station. The current Grand Central Terminal we see today officially opened on February 2, 1913. This magnificent structure was designed by the architectural firms Reed and Stem and Warren and Wetmore. A fascinating detail is that the famous celestial mural on the Main Concourse ceiling is actually painted upside down, showing the constellations from a divine perspective.

Gertrude Stein Gallery. This gallery was founded in 1963 by Gertrude Stein. It was located on Manhattan's Upper East Side. The gallery became a hub for artists working outside the mainstream. It was a strong supporter of the NO!art movement. The gallery closed its doors in 2026. A surprising fact is that Gertrude Stein was the first American woman to have a public statue erected in her honor in New York City.

The Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree is a world-famous holiday icon. The very first tree was put up by construction workers in 1931 during the Great Depression. It was a humble 20-foot balsam fir decorated with simple items like paper garlands and tin cans. The first official tree lighting ceremony happened in 1933 with a 50-foot tree and 700 lights. Over the years, the tree has grown in size and spectacle, becoming a symbol of hope and holiday cheer. In 1998, one tree even traveled to Rockefeller Center by being flown in on the world's second-largest transport plane at the time.

es.description: El árbol de Navidad del Rockefeller Center es un icono mundialmente famoso de las fiestas. El primer árbol fue colocado por obreros de la construcción en 1931, durante la Gran Depresión. Era un humilde abeto de 6 metros, decorado con elementos sencillos como guirnaldas de papel y latas. La primera ceremonia oficial de iluminación tuvo lugar en 1933, con un árbol de 15 metros y 700 luces. A lo largo de los años, el árbol ha crecido en tamaño y espectacularidad, convirtiéndose en un símbolo de esperanza y alegría navideña. En 1998, un árbol llegó al Rockefeller Center transportado en el segundo avión de carga más grande del mundo de la época.

pt-br.description: A Árvore de Natal do Rockefeller Center é um ícone mundialmente famoso das festas. A primeira árvore foi colocada por trabalhadores da construção em 1931, durante a Grande Depressão. Era um humilde abeto de 6 metros, decorado com itens simples como guirlandas de papel e latas. A primeira cerimônia oficial de iluminação aconteceu em 1933, com uma árvore de 15 metros e 700 luzes. Ao longo dos anos, a árvore cresceu em tamanho e espetáculo, tornando-se um símbolo de esperança e alegria natalina. Em 1998, uma árvore chegou ao Rockefeller Center sendo transportada no segundo maior avião cargueiro do mundo da época.

en.description: PlayStation Theater was a live events venue in New York City. It opened in September 2005. The venue was designed by architect David Rockwell. It was originally built as the Loews Astor Plaza movie theater, which opened in 1974. The space was converted into a live-event venue by the Anschutz Entertainment Group. The theater closed on December 31, 2019. It later reopened as Palladium Times Square. The venue featured an 85-foot-long LED screen, one of the largest marquees on Broadway. This massive screen could display live footage from the stage or anywhere else in the theater.

pt-br.description: A Placa da Caminhada da Marinha, dedicada em 24 de maio de 1947, fica na parte oeste da esplanada da fonte. Esta placa comemora as principais batalhas navais da Segunda Guerra Mundial. As árvores plantadas ao longo desta caminhada também homenageiam esses eventos. É um memorial silencioso, mas poderoso, que nos lembra do sacrifício e da bravura daqueles que serviram na marinha. A placa em si é um objeto de bronze com inscrições detalhadas. Ela foi criada para honrar a memória dos marinheiros e as vitórias conquistadas durante o conflito.

en.name: New York's Cinema — Ghostbusters, Avengers, Madagascar, Spider-Man, and More
en.description: New York City is the world's largest outdoor movie set, and this tour will take you through every scene. We'll visit Katz's Deli, complete with the exact table from "When Harry Met Sally." Then, the REAL Ghostbusters firehouse, still in operation today. You'll see the Flatiron Building, transformed into Spider-Man's Daily Bugle. We'll explore Grand Central, where the Avengers and Men in Black battled alien invasions. In Central Park, imagine the lions from Madagascar escaping the zoo. We'll see the NY Public Library, famously destroyed in "The Day After Tomorrow." At Rockefeller Center, picture Tom Hanks dancing in "Big." And DUMBO, with its iconic skyline featured in countless movie posters. Each spot, with the film that made it famous.

es.description: Nueva York es el plató de cine al aire libre más grande del mundo, ¡y esta ruta te llevará a cada escena! La Katz's Deli, con la placa exacta de la mesa de "Cuando Harry conoció a Sally". El cuartel REAL de los Cazafantasmas, aún operativo como estación de bomberos. El Flatiron Building, que se convirtió en el Daily Bugle de Spider-Man. El Grand Central, donde los Vengadores y los Hombres de Negro combatieron invasiones alienígenas. El Central Park, donde los leones de Madagascar escaparon del zoo. La Biblioteca Pública de Nueva York, destruida en "El día de mañana". El Rockefeller, donde Tom Hanks bailó en "Big". DUMBO, con ese skyline que aparece en todos los pósteres de películas. Cada lugar, con la película que allí sucedió.

A Biblioteca Pública de Nova Iorque, destruída em "O Dia Depois de Amanhã". O Rockefeller, onde Tom Hanks dançou em "Quero Ser Grande". DUMBO, com o horizonte que aparece em todos os cartazes de filmes. Cada local com o filme que lá aconteceu.

California Sea Lions are a fascinating sight here in New York! While they are native to the Pacific coast, some have found their way to our shores. The New York Aquarium has been a hub for these amazing animals, with a successful breeding program. Their first pup was born in 2010, and they've had many more since, including one born on Memorial Day in 2021! These sea lions are not just for show; they play a vital role in educating visitors about ocean conservation. Did you know that the U.S. Navy even trains California sea lions to detect underwater mines?

en.name: Orlando to NASA — The Complete Space Journey
en.description: Embark on the most epic space journey from Orlando! Head out from downtown and drive the entire Florida Space Coast, where the Atlantic Ocean meets the history of space exploration. Cruise through Titusville, home to the space museum and the best launch viewing spots. Cross over Merritt Island National Wildlife Refuge, then arrive at the Kennedy Space Center with real rockets and the Space Shuttle. Explore the historic Cape Canaveral Lighthouse, watch cruise ships set sail from the port, and finish with your toes in the sand at Cocoa Beach – where astronauts used to celebrate before heading to space. Less than an hour from Orlando, it's an unforgettable day.

es.name: Orlando hasta la NASA: La Ruta Espacial Completa
es.description: La aventura espacial más épica desde Orlando: sal del centro y recorre en coche toda la Space Coast de Florida, donde el Atlántico se encuentra con la historia de la conquista espacial. Pasa por Titusville con su museo espacial y el mejor mirador de lanzamientos, cruza la reserva natural de Merritt Island, llega al Kennedy Space Center con cohetes de verdad y el transbordador espacial, explora el faro histórico de Cape Canaveral, ve los cruceros zarpar del puerto y termina con los pies en la arena en Cocoa Beach, donde los astronautas celebraban antes de ir al espacio. A menos de una hora de Orlando y un día inolvidable.

pt-pt.name: De Orlando à NASA — A Rota Espacial Completa
pt-pt.description: A viagem espacial mais épica a partir de Orlando: saia do centro e percorra de carro toda a Space Coast da Flórida, onde o Atlântico se encontra com a história da conquista do espaço. Passe por Titusville com o seu museu espacial e o melhor miradouro para lançamentos, atravesse a reserva natural de Merritt Island, chegue ao Kennedy Space Center com foguetes reais e o vaivém espacial, explore o farol histórico de Cape Canaveral, veja os cruzeiros a zarpar do porto e termine com os pés na areia em Cocoa Beach — o local onde os astronautas celebravam antes de partir para o espaço. Menos de 1 hora de Orlando e um dia inesquecível.

en.description: Your ultimate Orlando shopping itinerary, right in the heart of the tourist district: International Drive. We're talking two Premium Outlets (I-Drive North and Vineland South, with over 300 stores combined!), Florida's most luxurious mall, Walmart, Costco, TJ Maxx, Ross, Marshalls, and Disney Springs – all along the main tourist corridor where many Brazilians stay. From designer brands with 65% off to unique American products you won't find anywhere else, you can spend a whole day shopping without ever leaving central Orlando.

en.name: Stone Mountain & Atlanta Parks — Nature and Family Fun
en.description: The perfect family itinerary in Atlanta: explore all that Stone Mountain Park has to offer — the world's largest granite sculpture, the cable car ride with spectacular views, the lake, the historic village, and the 19th-century trail. Afterward, discover other natural treasures nearby: Arabia Mountain with its pink rocks, Zoo Atlanta, and the parks that make this city one of the greenest in the American South. A full day of driving through the nature surrounding Atlanta.

Después, descubre otros tesoros naturales de los alrededores: la Arabia Mountain con sus rocas rosadas, el zoo de Atlanta y los parques que hacen de esta ciudad una de las más verdes del sur de Estados Unidos. Un día entero de coche por la naturaleza que rodea Atlanta.

en.name: The One with New York — A Fan's Guide to Friends
en.description: For Friends fans, New York City is an outdoor theme park. This itinerary takes you to the actual locations where the show was filmed externally: the iconic building at 90 Bedford Street, home to Monica's and Joey/Chandler's apartments, Phoebe's building on Morton Street, the American Museum of Natural History where Ross worked as a paleontologist, Bloomingdale's where Rachel had her job, Central Park featured in countless scenes, and much more. All confirmed – no fiction here. A walking tour through Greenwich Village and the West Side that will make any Friends fan go wild.

es.name: "El episodio de Nueva York: La ruta de los fans de Friends"
es.description: Para los fans de Friends, Nueva York es un parque temático al aire libre. Este recorrido te lleva por los lugares reales donde se rodaron las escenas exteriores de la serie: el emblemático edificio de Bedford Street, número 90, donde se encontraban los apartamentos de Monica y Joey/Chandler; el edificio de Phoebe en Morton Street; el Museo Americano de Historia Natural, donde Ross trabajaba como paleontólogo; los grandes almacenes Bloomingdale's, donde trabajaba Rachel; el Central Park, escenario de innumerables escenas, ¡y mucho más! Todo confirmado, nada inventado. Un itinerario a pie por Greenwich Village y el West Side que hará que cualquier fan de Friends se vuelva loco.

en.description: Grove Court is a charming enclave of six townhouses tucked away in the West Village. These homes were completed between 1853 and 1854. They were the idea of Samuel Cocks, a local businessman. He owned a grocery store nearby. Cocks wanted to attract more customers. So, he built these houses for tradesmen and laborers. They would then shop at his store. Originally, this alley was known as "Mixed Ale Alley." This was because of the drinks the residents consumed. Today, Grove Court is a very desirable and private place. It's even been featured in stories by O. Henry.

West Fourth Street Courts, also known as "The Cage," is a legendary public basketball court in Greenwich Village. The land was designated to the Parks department in 1934 and the playground officially opened in 1935. Basketball hoops were first installed in the 1950s. The court is famous for its non-regulation size, which is about half of a standard court. This unique dimension makes for a very physical and fast-paced game. Many famous NBA players, like Dr. J and Stephon Marbury, honed their skills here. The court is so iconic that it has been featured in video games and commercials. It's said that if the 3-point lines were regulation distance, they would nearly touch the half-court circle.

Balto Statue. This statue honors a brave Siberian Husky named Balto. In 1925, Nome, Alaska faced a diphtheria outbreak. Sled dogs delivered life-saving medicine through a terrible blizzard. Balto led the final, dangerous leg of this journey. The statue was unveiled in Central Park in 1925, just months after the event. It was sculpted by Frederick George Richard Roth. A unique detail is that Balto himself was present at the statue's unveiling ceremony.

La estatua se inauguró en Central Park en 1925, pocos meses después del suceso. Fue esculpida por Frederick George Richard Roth. Un detalle único es que el propio Balto estuvo presente en la ceremonia de inauguración de la estatua.

en.description: The 58th Street Library opened its doors on May 10, 1907. It was originally funded by Andrew Carnegie. The library moved to its current location in 1969. Today, it occupies two floors of an office building. This branch offers public computers and free Wi-Fi. It also has a community space that local groups can reserve. Interestingly, the library no longer charges late fines for returned items.

es.description: La Biblioteca de la 58ª Calle abrió sus puertas el 10 de mayo de 1907. Originalmente, fue financiada por Andrew Carnegie. La biblioteca se trasladó a su ubicación actual en 1969. Hoy en día, ocupa dos plantas de un edificio comercial. Esta sucursal ofrece ordenadores públicos y Wi-Fi gratuito. También hay un espacio comunitario que los grupos locales pueden reservar. Curiosamente, la biblioteca ya no cobra multas por retraso en los artículos devueltos.

en.description: The Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree is a world-famous holiday icon. The very first tree was put up by construction workers in 1931 during the Great Depression. It was a humble 20-foot balsam fir decorated with simple items like paper garlands and tin cans. The first official tree lighting ceremony happened in 1933 with a 50-foot tree and 700 lights. Over the years, the tree has grown in size and spectacle, becoming a symbol of hope and holiday cheer. In 1998, one tree even traveled to Rockefeller Center by being flown in on the world's second-largest transport plane at the time.

es.description: El árbol de Navidad del Rockefeller Center es un icono mundialmente famoso de las fiestas. El primer árbol fue colocado por obreros de la construcción en 1931, durante la Gran Depresión. Era un humilde abeto de 6 metros, decorado con elementos sencillos como guirnaldas de papel y latas. La primera ceremonia oficial de iluminación tuvo lugar en 1933, con un árbol de 15 metros y 700 luces. A lo largo de los años, el árbol ha crecido en tamaño y espectacularidad, convirtiéndose en un símbolo de esperanza y alegría navideña. En 1998, un árbol llegó al Rockefeller Center transportado en el segundo avión de carga más grande del mundo de la época.

pt-br.description: A Árvore de Natal do Rockefeller Center é um ícone mundialmente famoso das festas. A primeira árvore foi colocada por trabalhadores da construção em 1931, durante a Grande Depressão. Era um humilde abeto de 6 metros, decorado com itens simples como guirlandas de papel e latas. A primeira cerimônia oficial de iluminação aconteceu em 1933, com uma árvore de 15 metros e 700 luzes. Ao longo dos anos, a árvore cresceu em tamanho e espetáculo, tornando-se um símbolo de esperança e alegria natalina. Em 1998, uma árvore chegou ao Rockefeller Center sendo transportada no segundo maior avião cargueiro do mundo da época.

en.description: Grand Central Terminal is a truly iconic landmark. It first opened its doors in 1871 as Grand Central Depot. It was later rebuilt and renamed Grand Central Station. The current Grand Central Terminal we see today officially opened on February 2, 1913. This magnificent structure was designed by the architectural firms Reed and Stem and Warren and Wetmore. A fascinating detail is that the famous celestial mural on the Main Concourse ceiling is actually painted upside down, showing the constellations from a divine perspective.

en.name: The One with New York — A Fan's Guide to Friends (with Episodes!)
en.description: For *Friends* fans, New York City is an outdoor theme park! This itinerary takes you to the REAL locations where the show was filmed on the outside, with a nod to the episode each spot appeared in. The building at 90 Bedford Street is featured in ALL 236 episodes. We'll see Phoebe's street in S7E15. Ross's museum and that unforgettable date from S2E15. The Bloomingdale's where Rachel got her start in S3E10. Central Park, where Phoebe famously runs awkwardly in S6E7. All locations confirmed with sources. This walking tour through Greenwich Village and the Upper West Side will make any fan absolutely flip out!

es.name: El episodio de Nueva York: El recorrido de los fans de Friends (¡con episodios!)
es.description: Para los fans de Friends, Nueva York es un parque temático al aire libre. El edificio de 90 Bedford Street sale en TODOS los 236 episodios. La calle de Phoebe en la temporada 7, episodio 15. El museo de Ross y esa fecha inolvidable de la temporada 2, episodio 15. La Bloomingdale's donde empezó Rachel en la temporada 3, episodio 10. El Central Park donde Phoebe corre de forma peculiar en la temporada 6, episodio 7. Todos los lugares confirmados con fuentes. Un recorrido a pie por Greenwich Village y el Upper West Side que hará que cualquier fan se vuelva loco.

This has happened with comedians like Eddie Murphy.

en.name: Wall Street, the Bull, and 9/11 — New York's Financial District
en.description: Embark on a journey through the world's financial heart: from the New York Stock Exchange to the Charging Bull of Wall Street; from the 9/11 Memorial & Museum to One World Observatory with its breathtaking views; from the Federal Reserve Bank (home to the world's largest gold reserve, 6,000 tons!) to St. Paul's Chapel, which miraculously survived the attack. Conclude at the tip of Manhattan with a free view of the Statue of Liberty from the Staten Island Ferry Terminal. This walking tour explores New York's most powerful and historic neighborhood—where money and history collide.

es.name: Wall Street, el Toro y el 11-S: El Distrito Financiero de Nueva York
es.description: "Nuestro recorrido por el corazón financiero del mundo: desde la Bolsa de Nueva York hasta el Toro de Wall Street; desde el memorial del 11-S hasta el One World Trade Center con su mirador; desde el Banco de la Reserva Federal (¡donde se guarda el mayor depósito de oro del mundo, 6.000 toneladas!) hasta la Capilla de San Pablo, que sobrevivió milagrosamente al atentado. Terminaremos en la punta de Manhattan con la vista gratuita de la Estatua de la Libertad desde la Terminal del Ferry de Staten Island. Un recorrido a pie por el barrio más poderoso e histórico de Nueva York, donde el dinero y la historia se dan la mano."

pt-pt.name: Wall Street, o Touro e o 11 de Setembro — O Distrito Financeiro de Nova Iorque
pt-pt.description: Um passeio pelo coração financeiro do mundo: da Bolsa de Nova Iorque ao Touro de Wall Street; do memorial do 11 de Setembro ao One World Trade Center com o seu miradouro; do Federal Reserve Bank (onde se encontra o maior depósito de ouro do mundo, 6.000 toneladas!) à St. Paul's Chapel, que sobreviveu milagrosamente ao ataque. Termine na ponta de Manhattan com a vista gratuita da Estátua da Liberdade no Staten Island Ferry Terminal. Um roteiro a pé pelo bairro mais poderoso e histórico de Nova Iorque — onde o dinheiro e a história se cruzam.

pt-br.description: O roteiro pelo coração financeiro do mundo: da Bolsa de Nova York ao Touro de Wall Street; do memorial do 11 de setembro à One World Trade Center com seu deck de observação; da Federal Reserve Bank (onde fica o maior depósito de ouro do mundo, 6.000 toneladas!) à St. Paul's Chapel que sobreviveu milagrosamente ao ataque. stops.name: Church of Our Lady of Victory

en.description: Church of Our Lady of Victory. This church was founded in 1944 by Cardinal Francis Spellman. It is known as the War Memorial Church. Construction was completed in 1946, and it was dedicated on June 23, 1947. The land for the church was donated by Major Edward Bowes. The church's dedication commemorates the ongoing actions during World War II. A special feature is the Teresa Benedicta Auschwitz Memorial in the lobby, which commemorates a victim of the Holocaust.

Wavertree. This incredible ship was launched in 1885 in England. It's one of the last large sailing ships made of iron. Wavertree carried all sorts of cargo around the world. It even survived a terrible storm off Cape Horn! After many years, it was found in South America and brought to New York. Today, it's a star attraction at the South Street Seaport Museum. Imagine the adventures this ship has seen!

es.description: Wavertree. Este increíble barco se botó en 1885 en Inglaterra. Es uno de los últimos grandes veleros de hierro. El Wavertree transportó todo tipo de carga por el mundo. ¡Incluso sobrevivió a una terrible tormenta cerca del Cabo de Hornos! Tras muchos años, fue encontrado en Sudamérica y traído a Nueva York. Hoy, es una atracción estrella en el South Street Seaport Museum. ¡Imagina las aventuras que ha vivido este barco!

pt-br.description: Wavertree. Este navio incrível foi lançado em 1885 na Inglaterra. É um dos últimos grandes veleiros feitos de ferro. O Wavertree transportou todo tipo de carga pelo mundo. Ele até sobreviveu a uma terrível tempestade perto do Cabo Horn! Após muitos anos, foi encontrado na América do Sul e trazido para Nova York. Hoje, é uma atração de destaque no South Street Seaport Museum. Imagine as aventuras que este navio já viveu!

en.description: Brooklyn Bridge. Construction on this iconic landmark began in 1870 and it officially opened on May 24, 1883. It was designed by John Augustus Roebling, and after his death, his son Washington Roebling took over, with his wife Emily Roebling playing a crucial role in its completion. This engineering marvel was the longest suspension bridge in the world when it opened. A surprising fact is that Emily Roebling was the first person to cross the completed bridge, and she carried a rooster with her as a symbol of victory.

es.description: El Puente de Brooklyn. La construcción de este emblemático monumento comenzó en 1870 y se inauguró oficialmente el 24 de mayo de 1883. Fue diseñado por John Augustus Roebling, y tras su fallecimiento, su hijo Washington Roebling tomó las riendas, con su esposa Emily Roebling desempeñando un papel crucial en su finalización. Esta maravilla de la ingeniería fue el puente colgante más largo del mundo cuando se abrió. Un dato sorprendente es que Emily Roebling fue la primera persona en cruzar el puente terminado, y llevaba un gallo con ella como símbolo de victoria.

pt-br.description: Ponte do Brooklyn. A construção deste marco icônico começou em 1870 e ela foi oficialmente inaugurada em 24 de maio de 1883. Foi projetada por John Augustus Roebling e, após sua morte, seu filho Washington Roebling assumiu, com sua esposa Emily Roebling desempenhando um papel crucial em sua conclusão. Esta maravilha da engenharia foi a ponte suspensa mais longa do mundo quando foi inaugurada. Um fato surpreendente é que Emily Roebling foi a primeira pessoa a cruzar a ponte concluída, e ela carregava um galo consigo como símbolo de vitória.
